references.text: God himself says "It is not good" (לֹא־טוֹב) regarding human loneliness, the same expression Jethro uses about Moses' situation
Moses complains about the burden of leading the people alone, and God commands him to appoint seventy elders to help him
Moses recounts how he could not carry the people alone and needed to appoint leaders
Moses describes the appointment of wise and experienced men as leaders over the people, in line with Jethro's advice
A proverb about accepting counsel and guidance from others, just as Moses received advice from his father-in-law
The apostles realize they cannot do everything themselves and delegate tasks to seven men, a principle similar to Jethro's advice
This verse shows the outcome of the advice in the source passage: Moses' obedience to his father-in-law leading to a better leadership structure.
